label: target1: supplied next-week close-to-close log-return label; expm1 for simple returns
rank_ic: Spearman correlation within each signal week; mean over valid weeks
rank_icir: mean weekly Rank IC / sample standard deviation; NOT annualized
ndcg_at5: weekly relevance=floor((target rank - 1)*5/N), clipped 0..4; gain=2^relevance-1; log2 discounts; ties average
portfolio_pnl: uses supplied buy/sell price proxies and integer shares; NOT target1
delta: new minus old; less negative max_drawdown means smaller observed drawdown
